messages:
alex: Kicking off the semi-quarterly recurring-incident pattern review. I analyzed incidents from 2025-01-01..2025-06-30 and grouped by recurring root cause. Top themes: autoscaler oscillation, DB failover storms during deploys, cache thundering on cold starts, and config-drift (node labels). Doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/recurring-patterns-1752000456
maria: Thanks alex. Can you paste the incident IDs and count per category?
alex: Sure. totals: 64 incidents, repeats: 16. autoscaler 18%, db-failover 17%, cache-thundering 13%, config-drift 9%. IDs in doc (INC-5501, INC-5612, INC-5650...).
devon: Autoscaler looks like two sub-causes: noisy sidecar metrics and short CPU spikes from batch jobs. We should separate mitigations.
sree: For DB failovers: client reconnect storms are the main pain. Short-term: client retry jitter and exponential backoff. Long-term: graceful failover handoff. I'll own client changes. ETA: 2025-04-02.
alex: Autoscaler short-term fix: increase cooldown to 60s and require two consecutive breach samples. Owner: alex. ETA: 2025-03-12. Long-term: queue-length based scaling.
maria: Cache thundering common during canary/cold deploys. Proposal: deploy hook to pre-warm top-100 prefixes and progressive invalidation. Owner: sree. ETA: 2025-03-20.
ops-bot: automated-summary: period=2025-01-01..2025-06-30, total_incidents=64, repeat_root_cause=16
devon: Please create explicit JIRA tickets with acceptance criteria and regression tests. Target: reduce repeat incident rate by 50% QoQ.
alex: Will open tickets and add perf harness for autoscaler noise.
sree: I'll add a new column in the postmortem template "Repeat? (Y/N)" and tag repeats with pattern-family for easier queries.
maria: Assignments recap:
 - DB client backoff + jitter  owner: devon  ETA: 2025-04-02
 - Autoscaler smoothing + metric gating  owner: alex  ETA: 2025-03-12
 - Cache pre-warm + progressive invalidation  owner: sree  ETA: 2025-03-20
 - Config drift detection (label linting)  owner: maria  ETA: 2025-04-10
ops-bot: scheduled: monthly follow-up reminders on the 5th at 10:00, first_ping=2025-03-05
maria: I'll add these actions to the follow-up board and create a calendar check-in in two weeks. If anyone needs to reassign, reply here.
devon: ack
sree: ack
alex: ack
